results.title: Youth Worker Salary in Australia 2026 - Hader Institute
results.description:
## Youth worker salary in Australia: the short answer
Youth workers in Australia typically **start on around $61,000 to $72,000** a year in advertised entry roles, rising toward an average of about **$87,800** with experience, according to [Jobs and Skills Australia](https://www.yourcareer.gov.au/occupations/411716/youth-worker). Most roles sit under the **SCHADS Award** (a full-time floor near **$68,000**), and future demand is rated **strong**.

- **Award entry floor (SCHADS):** $68,000 / year ($34 / hour)

## What is the average youth worker salary in Australia?
| Measure | Figure |
|-|-|
| Average full-time pay | **$1,688/week (~$87,800/year)** |
| People employed | ~16,200 |
| Full-time share | 62% |
| Future demand | **Strong** (trending up) |

## Youth worker pay by qualification
_Source: SEEK in-sector advertised ranges;_ [_Jobs and Skills Australia_](https://www.yourcareer.gov.au/occupations/411716/youth-worker) _occupation average;_ [_Fair Work SCHADS Award_](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/pay-and-wages/minimum-wages/social-and-community-services-industry-pay-rates) _floor ~$68,000._

## Frequently asked questions
### How much do youth workers earn in Australia?
Youth workers typically **start on around $61,000 to $72,000** in advertised entry roles, rising to an average of about **$87,800** with experience, according to Jobs and Skills Australia. The SCHADS Award sets a full-time floor near $68,000.

### What are typical youth worker wages in Australia?
The SCHADS Award sets the minimum pay rate, a full-time floor near $68,000.
